messages:
sam-sales: Need final numbers for a commit proposal with throughput guarantees. Customer attached traffic: steady 180 RPS gen, short peaks to 2.5k RPS for ~7m, avg 300 tokens, mixed chat+rerank+embeds. Wants burst plan and preheat for demo week.
tina-se: quick read: mixed long-context chat (~60%), batching helps but long ctx reduces batch density. With quantized weights and KV caching ~35% hit, a single A100-eq node handles ~180 steady mixed RPS. For 2.5k peak you need ~14 warm nodes minimum.
jules-ml: recommend preheat window 8 minutes to warm weights + KV. For demo determinism, prewarm min_warm equal to baseline. Also run a perf smoke: 2-stage ramp to peak, hold 7m, capture p95/p99.
omar-fin: need two pricing tiers for PO: economical (p95) and conservative (p99). What baseline counts?
tina-se: propose: economical: baseline 12 reserved, burst to 40 (payg for extras), autoscale target 0.65. conservative: baseline 20 reserved, burst to 48, multi-AZ (8/6/6). Call out that p99 needs extra baseline to avoid cold starts.
osps-bot: reserve-intent-90123 logged for 12->40 burst pool (awaiting finance).
omar-fin: I'll model costs for both and attach spreadsheet. If customer wants committed burst credits we'll include a second pricing table.
tina-se: include this autoscale snippet in PO (paste as string):
"{
  "policy": "target_utilization",
  "target": "0.65",
  "scale_up": "step:6,cooldown:180",
  "scale_down": "step:3,cooldown:300",
  "preheat": "enabled:true,window_s:480,min_warm:12",
  "burst_pool": "enabled:true,max_nodes:40,spot_fallback:true"
}"
tina-se: also note tenant isolation for Dedicated -> preheat uses customer-only pool; add security sentence to PO.
sam-sales: great. I'll send PO with both options and schedule sign-off call. tagging customer for demo confirmation.
omar-fin: attaching pricing link in channel shortly.
ops-bot: audit-event-4721 created for preheat ops.
sam-sales: thanks team :thumbsup:
